note: Bank Muscat's schedule of service charges (version 2.12/2026): a current account's minimum balance fee is 0.500 rials a month plus 0.025 VAT if the daily balance falls below 200 rials; none for a salary under 500 rials a month or an account receiving a pension (not modelled).
